mapper.select: SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.email, u.display_name, c.password_hash, c.failed_attempts, c.locked_until, m.id AS member_id, m.organization_id, o.name AS organization_name, m.role FROM app_user u JOIN local_user_credential c ON c.user_id = u.id JOIN organization_member m ON m.user_id = u.id JOIN organization o ON o.id = m.organization_id WHERE lower(u.email) = lower(#{email}) AND m.organization_id = #{organizationId} AND u.auth_provider = 'LOCAL' AND u.status = 'ACTIVE' AND m.status = 'ACTIVE' AND o.status = 'ACTIVE' LIMIT 1

SELECT s.id AS session_id, s.user_id, s.organization_id, s.member_id, u.email, u.display_name, o.name AS organization_name, m.role, s.expires_at FROM auth_session s JOIN app_user u ON u.id = s.user_id JOIN organization_member m ON m.id = s.member_id AND m.organization_id = s.organization_id JOIN organization o ON o.id = s.organization_id WHERE s.token_hash = #{tokenHash} AND s.expires_at > #{now} AND s.revoked_at IS NULL AND u.status = 'ACTIVE' AND m.status = 'ACTIVE' AND o.status = 'ACTIVE' LIMIT 1
mapper.update: WITH reset_credential AS ( UPDATE local_user_credential SET failed_attempts = 0, locked_until = NULL WHERE user_id = #{userId} RETURNING user_id ) UPDATE app_user SET last_login_at = #{now}, updated_at = #{now} WHERE id IN (SELECT user_id FROM reset_credential)
